column3: NKJV includes “and divisions,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV has “are you not carnal,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “are you not merely human.”
NKJV has the order “Paul … Apollos” and “but ministers,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Apollos … Paul” and simply “ministers.”
